prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original cinematic landscape artwork for Sahil Kumar's portfolio hero. Wide landscape, 1536x1024 or wider. Deep plum-black night sky with a few very fine stars. Upper 40% and left 40% remain predominantly near-black plum, quietly atmospheric, suitable for white text overlay. Sun has a few subtle horizontal atmospheric bands. No wireframe grids, buildings, people, text, logos, watermarks, UI or borders. Reference mood: neon cyberpunk sunset over water, not a generic purple gradient. This is an original image, not a copy of any stock image.
